bug_semantics: Stored XSS through the admin appearance logo uploader. POST /admin accepts logoNavbar and logoLogin as FileType fields constrained only with Symfony Image() (no mime-type allowlist) and HTML accept=image/*. FileUploaderService then writes the file under public/uploads using UploadedFile::guessExtension(), so a script-bearing SVG is stored as logo-navbar.svg or logo-login.svg and served as a static document. Direct GET of /uploads/logo-navbar.svg?_=<id> or /uploads/logo-login.svg?_=<id> executes the embedded script in the visitor's browser. The PoC SVG is <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none"><script>alert(...)</script></svg>. CVSS lists PR:H (admin session required to upload); the GHSA/CVE named range is NovoSGA <= 2.2.9.
flaw_origin: The full sink was first written in a single non-merge commit, b55a045d1f92eb8f891737936f30370dbbd67102 (feat: Application settings, 2024-11-08). That commit added AppearanceSettingsFormType with unconstrained new Image() plus accept image/* for both logo fields, added FileUploaderService::upload() which persists guessed extensions into public/uploads, and wired AdminController::index to call upload($file, 'logo-navbar'|'logo-login') after form validation. Immediate parent e683e6badaa8bfe012986ee6699ededd76201518 has none of those files and no logoNavbar/logoLogin/FileUploader paths. Later 0887c83/2d87134 only moved form wiring; they did not introduce the mechanism.
